origin.windyorigins.mirrored.name: The Mirrored
origin.windyorigins.mirrored.description: You exist on the far side of the reflection, where the world is empty and nothing can find you. Reality rejects you, and you can bear it only moments at a time.
power.windyorigins.glass_body.name: Dead Reflection
power.windyorigins.glass_body.descriptio: You have only 7 hearts, and you are undead — a reflection was never alive to begin with.
power.windyorigins.water_phobia.name: Hydrophobia
power.windyorigins.water_phobia.descript: Water severs your tie to the Normal World. Any contact throws you straight back into the Mirror World, and while you are in it your active powers will not work.
power.windyorigins.reality_toxicity.name: Reality Toxicity
power.windyorigins.reality_toxicity.desc: The Normal World poisons you. After 10 seconds there you are struck by Slowness and Weakness, after 20 seconds you begin taking damage, and after 25 seconds you die.
power.windyorigins.phase_shift.name: Phase Shift
power.windyorigins.phase_shift.descripti: [Primary active] Switches phase. Returning to the Mirror World is free; stepping into the Normal World costs 6 hunger and all saturation.
power.windyorigins.banishment_punch.name: Banishment Punch
power.windyorigins.banishment_punch.desc: [Secondary active] Charges your fist for 3 seconds. A bare-handed hit on a creature in that time sends it to the opposite phase. A banished player returns to their own phase after 5 minutes, or at once by charging a respawn anchor with glowstone. This blow does not count as violence.
power.windyorigins.spawn_in_mirror.name: Mirror Spawn
power.windyorigins.spawn_in_mirror.descr: You are born and reborn in the Mirror World.
power.windyorigins.glass_skin.name: Glass Skin
power.windyorigins.glass_skin.descriptio: Your skin takes on a translucent, glassy hue.
origin.windyorigins.bounty_hunter.name: Stalker
origin.windyorigins.bounty_hunter.descri: There is no target that cannot be found and no armour that cannot be broken — only a price. Without a contract you are slow, soft and barely worth fearing; with one, you are the only thing your quarry should be afraid of.
power.windyorigins.mark_of_death.name: Mark of Death
power.windyorigins.mark_of_death.descrip: [Primary active] Marks the creature you are looking at, up to 100 blocks away. The mark lasts 1 minute and each of your hits adds 3 seconds. Only you see the target's outline and always know the distance to it; the target only knows it is hunted and stops seeing creatures and players past 12 blocks (terrain stays visible). The mark breaks if the target gets more than 150 blocks away or spends over 5 seconds in the other Mirror phase. Cooldown: 2 minutes from the end of the contract. Killing a marked player clears it at once; a slain mob refunds only part, from 15% for small fry to 55% for a boss.
power.windyorigins.duelist.name: Duelist
power.windyorigins.duelist.description: Against your mark you deal 25% more damage, a quarter of its attacks miss you, and every swing at it gives back a quarter of your attack cooldown.
power.windyorigins.crippling_shot.name: Crippling Shot
power.windyorigins.crippling_shot.descri: Arrows and other projectiles that hit your mark leave it with Slowness III for 1.5 seconds. Snowballs, eggs and thrown potions do not count.
power.windyorigins.pursuit.name: Pursuit
power.windyorigins.pursuit.description: While you are closing the distance to your mark, you move with Speed II.
power.windyorigins.dossier.name: Dossier
power.windyorigins.dossier.description: Your contract panel shows the target's health and armour. A marked player hides nothing from you: hunger, hotbar, off-hand and active effects.
power.windyorigins.blood_money.name: Blood Money
power.windyorigins.blood_money.descripti: A fulfilled contract pays. Loot drops as if with Looting III and goes straight into your inventory, experience comes to you multiplied by how dangerous the target was (×1 to ×10), and a bounty is paid on top — from gold nuggets for small fry to diamonds and netherite scrap for bosses. A player's bounty is their head.
power.windyorigins.free_step.name: Free Step
power.windyorigins.free_step.description: Cobwebs do not slow you down.
power.windyorigins.heavy_weapon.name: Heavy Weapon
power.windyorigins.heavy_weapon.descript: Your attack speed is 25% lower while you hold no contract. The moment you mark something, the penalty is gone.
power.windyorigins.weakened_strikes.name: Weakened Strikes
power.windyorigins.weakened_strikes.desc: You deal 25% less damage to anything that is not your mark.
power.windyorigins.exposed.name: Exposed
power.windyorigins.exposed.description: Attacks from anyone other than your mark deal 25% more damage to you.
power.windyorigins.interference_shock.de: Any damage taken without a contract causes Nausea and Slowness for 4 seconds, at most once every 9 seconds.
power.windyorigins.scarce_loot.name: Scarce Loot
power.windyorigins.scarce_loot.descripti: Creatures you kill without a contract give half as much: every stack of two or more items is halved, and so is the experience. Single items are left alone.
power.windyorigins.despised_mercenary.de: Villagers charge you a quarter more for every trade.
message.windyorigins.bounty.busy: You are already on a contract
message.windyorigins.bounty.released: The hunt is over… for now
message.windyorigins.bounty.broken.too_f: Contract broken: the target got away
message.windyorigins.bounty.broken.lost: Contract broken: the trail went cold
message.windyorigins.bounty.broken.other: Contract broken: the target slipped into another phase
origin.windyorigins.frostborn.name: Frostborn
origin.windyorigins.frostborn.descriptio: Born of the long winter, you carry the cold inside you. Where you walk, water hardens into ice and enemies stiffen with frost — but warmth drains you, and fire is your undoing.
power.windyorigins.chill.name: Chill
power.windyorigins.chill.description: Your inner cold, shown as a bar. Snowy biomes, ice, snow and powder snow fill it; warm biomes, fire, lava and the Nether drain it. In temperate lands it settles at 40.
power.windyorigins.frost_walk.name: Frost Walk
power.windyorigins.frost_walk.descriptio: Still water within 2–4 blocks below you turns to melting ice, wider the more Chill you have. You cannot dive — the water freezes first. Works in a boat and on horseback too.
power.windyorigins.frost_aura.name: Frost Aura
power.windyorigins.frost_aura.descriptio: Hostile creatures within 2–5 blocks freeze as if stuck in powder snow, wider the more Chill you have.
power.windyorigins.frost_touch.name: Frost Touch
power.windyorigins.frost_touch.descripti: Your hits leave Slowness for 2 seconds.
power.windyorigins.ice_coffin.name: Ice Coffin
power.windyorigins.ice_coffin.descriptio: [Primary Active] Seals you in a block of ice for 5 seconds: no damage gets through and you recover 5 hearts, but you cannot move, attack or use items. Needs at least 20 Chill and spends all of it. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
power.windyorigins.ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
power.windyorigins.ice_wall.description: [Secondary Active] Raises a 3×3 wall of ice 3 blocks ahead of you; it crumbles after 15 seconds. Costs 30 Chill. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
power.windyorigins.permafrost.name: Permafrost
power.windyorigins.permafrost.descriptio: Grass under your feet gets a dusting of snow.
power.windyorigins.cold_blooded.name: Child of Frost
power.windyorigins.cold_blooded.descript: You never freeze, and you walk on powder snow as if wearing leather boots.
power.windyorigins.thaw.name: Thaw
power.windyorigins.thaw.description: With no Chill left you suffer Weakness and Slowness. While you carry snow or ice, it melts instead: a snowball holds for half a second, a snow layer for one, a snow block or ice for two, packed ice or a powder snow bucket for four, blue ice for eight. Five stacks of snow blocks last 10 minutes in the Nether.
power.windyorigins.meltable.name: Meltable
power.windyorigins.meltable.description: Fire and lava deal 50% more damage to you.
power.windyorigins.raw_diet.name: Raw Diet
power.windyorigins.raw_diet.description: Cooked food gives you half as much; raw food is fine.
origin.windyorigins.luminian.name: Luminian
origin.windyorigins.luminian.description: A spark of the first dawn in mortal form. You light up every cave you enter and burn the dead with your presence — but a light cannot hide, and in the dark you slowly go out.
power.windyorigins.inner_light.name: Inner Light
power.windyorigins.inner_light.descripti: Your own light, shown as a bar. It fills fastest under the open daytime sky, slowly near other light sources within 7 blocks, and drains in darkness. The fuller it is, the brighter you shine.
power.windyorigins.radiance.name: Radiance
power.windyorigins.radiance.description: You are a light source: the space around you is lit up to level 15, depending on your Inner Light, and everyone can see your glow through walls.
power.windyorigins.dawn_rebirth.name: Dawn Rebirth
power.windyorigins.dawn_rebirth.descript: Instead of dying you rise again with half your health. A flash sets the undead around you on fire and blinds everything else within 8 blocks. Needs at least 50 Inner Light and spends 50. Recharges for 15 minutes, even through death.
power.windyorigins.sunlit_mending.name: Sunlit Mending
power.windyorigins.sunlit_mending.descri: Under the open sky by day you slowly regenerate.
power.windyorigins.holy_light.name: Holy Light
power.windyorigins.holy_light.descriptio: You deal 25% more damage to the undead.
power.windyorigins.dimming.name: Dimming
power.windyorigins.dimming.description: With no Inner Light left you suffer Weakness and slowly take damage.
power.windyorigins.beacon.name: Beacon
power.windyorigins.beacon.description: Hostile creatures notice you from 50% farther, and crouching does not help you hide: your name tag stays visible as far, and through walls, as if you stood upright.
power.windyorigins.undead_hatred.name: Hated by the Dead
power.windyorigins.undead_hatred.descrip: Undead that can see you always choose you as their target.
origin.windyorigins.folded.name: The Folded
origin.windyorigins.folded.description: You were born in a pocket of space folded inside our world, and half of you is still there. The ground holds you loosely, and home is always within reach of your hand.
power.windyorigins.fold.name: Fold
power.windyorigins.fold.description: The pocket of space you came from, shown as a bar. It refills by itself, and all your abilities draw on it.
power.windyorigins.fold_rifle.name: Fold Rifle
power.windyorigins.fold_rifle.descriptio: The rifle lives in the fold: it is always in your inventory and cannot be dropped, stored or taken. Hold for 1.25 seconds while the scope narrows, then release. The shot is instant and lands exactly on the crosshair up to 160 blocks away: a hit on your screen is a hit. 9.5 hearts of damage that pierces armour (Protection enchantments and shields still work). A shot costs 45 Fold. You cannot aim unseen: for the last half second of the charge, and for as long as the rifle is held ready, every player near your line of fire sees a glint where you are and hears it ring.
power.windyorigins.fold_hover.name: Hover
power.windyorigins.fold_hover.descriptio: [Primary active] Toggles hovering: Space rises, Shift descends, and you drift sideways a little slower than walking. You can only rise while the ground is within 8 blocks below. Drains Fold. Touching the ground ends the hover. When Fold runs out or you switch the hover off, you drop quickly but softly, with no fall damage. Shooting while hovering pushes you back.
power.windyorigins.fold_step.name: Step into the Fold
power.windyorigins.fold_step.description: [Secondary Active] For 1.5 seconds you are invisible and untouchable, and whatever was chasing you loses track. Costs 40 Fold. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
power.windyorigins.fold_pocket.name: Pocket
power.windyorigins.fold_pocket.descripti: [Load Toolbar key] Nine slots of storage inside your fold, kept through death.
power.windyorigins.half_weight.name: Half-Weight
power.windyorigins.half_weight.descripti: You take half damage from falling.
power.windyorigins.thin_frame.name: Thin Frame
power.windyorigins.weak_grip.name: Weak Grip
power.windyorigins.weak_grip.description: You deal 60% less damage in melee.
origin.windyorigins.sanguine.name: Sanguine
origin.windyorigins.sanguine.description: Night's aristocrat, kept alive by the blood of others. Every victim lends you a trace of what it was — but hunger makes a beast of you, and the sun never forgives.
power.windyorigins.blood_thirst.name: Blood Thirst
power.windyorigins.blood_thirst.descript: Your hunger bar is blood. Ordinary food does not nourish you at all.
power.windyorigins.bite.name: Bite
power.windyorigins.bite.description: Crouch and strike with an empty hand to drink. Livestock gives little, villagers a lot, players the most. Bosses cannot be bitten; undead blood is dead and causes nausea; golems have no blood at all.
power.windyorigins.blood_taste.name: Taste of Blood
power.windyorigins.blood_taste.descripti: The last blood you drank grants its trait for 2 minutes. Arthropods: wall climbing. Sea creatures: water breathing and fast swimming. Nether creatures: fire resistance. Flyers and chickens: slow falling. Illagers, witches and piglins: +20% damage. Villagers: blood drains half as fast. End creatures: night vision. Predators (wolves, foxes, cats, bears): Speed. Livestock: Haste. Horses, rabbits, frogs and goats: Jump Boost II. Creepers: explosions hurt half as much. Slimes: no fall damage. A player's blood carries whatever they last ate or drank.
power.windyorigins.thirst.name: Thirst
power.windyorigins.thirst.description: Above half blood you are sated. Below half you are thirsty and 20% faster. Nearly empty, you become a starving beast: 40% faster and stronger, and every hit is a bite — at anyone, friends included.
power.windyorigins.vampirism.name: Vampirism
power.windyorigins.vampirism.description: Your hits heal you for 15% of the damage while you are sated, 30% as the beast.
power.windyorigins.blood_sense.name: Blood Sense
power.windyorigins.blood_sense.descripti: While thirsty you see every living thing within 16 blocks through walls.
power.windyorigins.bat_form.name: Bat Form
power.windyorigins.bat_form.description: [Secondary Active] Burst into a cloud of bats and fly for 6 seconds. You cannot attack or use items. Costs 4 blood. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
power.windyorigins.day_rest.name: Day Rest
power.windyorigins.day_rest.description: A bed by day sets your spawn point and restores blood once a day, without skipping time.
power.windyorigins.sunburn.name: Sunburn
power.windyorigins.sunburn.description: Direct sunlight sets you on fire after a moment of warning smoke. A helmet protects you but wears out quickly.
power.windyorigins.aspen.name: Aspen
power.windyorigins.aspen.description: Wooden weapons and sticks deal triple damage to you.
power.windyorigins.running_water.name: Running Water
power.windyorigins.running_water.descrip: Flowing water slows you down heavily.
power.windyorigins.undead_blood.name: Undead
power.windyorigins.undead_blood.descript: You are undead: healing and harming are reversed, and Smite hurts you more.
origin.windyorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origin.windyorigins.revenant.description: A soul that refused to leave. Alone you are frail; inside another you are their second heartbeat — and even death gives you ten seconds to settle the score.
power.windyorigins.echo.name: Echo
power.windyorigins.echo.description: When a hostile creature or a player dies nearby its soul lingers for 10 seconds. Peaceful animals leave no Echo. Only Revenants in its phase can see the soul; touch it yourself or send a wisp for it to gather an Echo, up to 10.
power.windyorigins.possess.name: Possession
power.windyorigins.possess.description: [Primary active] Possess the creature you are looking at within 6 blocks, friend or foe. You stay inside for 5 seconds, healing yourself and it; you cannot be shaken off and a hostile host forgets its target. Near the end each Echo adds 10 seconds, to no more than 55 in all. Press the key again, crouch or jump to leave. Leaving, by choice or when time runs out, flings you out of the host: along the movement keys you hold and a little upwards, or the way the host was facing if you hold none. That flight deals you no fall damage. Cooldown: 1 minute.
power.windyorigins.summon_wisps.name: Wisps
power.windyorigins.summon_wisps.descript: [Secondary active] For 3 Echo, calls three helper wisps for 2 minutes. Press again to send them out one at a time to whatever you are looking at (up to 24 blocks). A block: the wisp digs it and up to five more of the same next to it and brings back the drops. An enemy: it torments them for 15 seconds with Slowness, Weakness, damage and an outline through walls; no more than two wisps on one player at a time. A player, pet or peaceful creature: it heals and hastens them for 20 seconds (crouch to torment instead). Empty air: it gathers nearby items, experience and Echoes; crouching, it tends you. After an errand a wisp rests for 5 seconds.
power.windyorigins.stillness.name: Stillness
power.windyorigins.stillness.description: Stand still for 2 seconds and you vanish completely, armour included.
power.windyorigins.vengeance.name: Vengeance
power.windyorigins.vengeance.description: Death does not take you at once: for 10 seconds you are an invulnerable ghost, flying as in Creative mode, through walls too; you see your killer and strike through armour at full strength, inflicting Weakness. You cannot touch blocks. Then you fade, and your items drop where you died. Not in the void and not from /kill.
power.windyorigins.soul_stride.name: Soul Stride
power.windyorigins.soul_stride.descripti: Soul sand and soul soil do not slow you; they speed you up by 30%.
power.windyorigins.faded_body.name: Faded Body
power.windyorigins.feeble_hands.name: Feeble Hands
power.windyorigins.feeble_hands.descript: You deal 30% less damage in melee. The ghost of Vengeance is not affected.
power.windyorigins.light_garb.name: Light Garb
power.windyorigins.light_garb.descriptio: You can wear nothing heavier than chainmail.
message.windyorigins.sanguine.rested: You rest, and the blood returns
origin.windyorigins.host.name: The Host
origin.windyorigins.host.description: A chip in your temple, and in the chip - Volta: quick, clever, bored easily. She fights, scouts and works for you, but every request heats the chip, and an overheated chip takes your mind with it.
power.windyorigins.heat.name: Heat
power.windyorigins.heat.description: The chip takes three or four requests in a row: each heats it by 20–45%, and a search through rock by 25% to 90% depending on how rare the thing is. It cools slowly, 1% every second and a half, and only after 10 seconds of peace: no commands, no damage, no rain. Rain heats it by 2% a second, water by 4%, and lightning nearby overheats it instantly. From 40% interference tears at the picture and shakes the camera, worse the hotter it runs.
power.windyorigins.volta.name: Volta
power.windyorigins.volta.description: [Hold V] Your companion is a hologram everyone can see; her energy is drawn for your eyes only. Hold the key to open the command wheel (four pages). Combat: overload, virus, optics glitch, impulse, puppet, siphon, swap, zero gravity. Tricks: decoy, turret, barrier, slow time, rewind, blink, repair, scan. Chores: magnet, toggle, light, tunnel, build, harvest. Or just say it in chat the way you would to a person, in any of ten languages: "Volta, find diamonds", "hey volta, zap that zombie", "volta, where is Steve_123?", "chop this tree", "dig down 10", "shield me". After you address her she listens for 15 seconds without her name. She needs a second and a half between any two requests.
power.windyorigins.volta_pranks.name: Wilful
power.windyorigins.volta_pranks.descript: Every 1–2.5 minutes Volta plays a prank, and it is dangerous: she spins you around, tosses you six blocks up with no soft landing, shoves you in a random direction, rubber-bands you a few seconds back, throws the item out of your hand, shuffles your hotbar, swaps your movement keys, whistles every monster within 24 blocks onto you, blinds you, mirrors or blacks out the screen, hides the HUD, screams across the whole view or fakes your death. She does not care whether it is a fight, a bridge over a drop or mid-flight. She spares only those under a quarter health or in water or lava, and waits while a chest or your inventory is open. Quiet mode stops pranks and chatter for just 3 minutes, and can be asked for again only after 20.
power.windyorigins.cyberpsychosis.name: Cyberpsychosis
power.windyorigins.cyberpsychosis.descri: At full Heat the chip burns out for 15 seconds: Nausea, jolts of damage, Volta falls silent, every command is locked and you take 50% more damage.
power.windyorigins.chip_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.windyorigins.chip_slot.name: Occupied Temple
power.windyorigins.chip_slot.description: The chip takes the head slot: you cannot wear a helmet.
power.windyorigins.power_hungry.name: Power-Hungry
power.windyorigins.power_hungry.descript: The chip eats: you get hungry 30% faster.
power.windyorigins.short_circuit.name: Short Circuit
power.windyorigins.short_circuit.descrip: In water Volta's commands do not work and the chip, instead of cooling, heats quickly; trying to give an order underwater heats it further.
message.windyorigins.volta.overheat: Chip is melting, give me a second!
message.windyorigins.volta.psychosis_end: Phew... I'm back. Don't do that again.
message.windyorigins.volta.fetch_none: No "%s" in any chest I can see from here. It has to be in your view: I don't reach through walls or behind your back.
message.windyorigins.volta.no_blocks: You've got nothing to build with.
message.windyorigins.volta.no_torches: No torches. Borrow my eyes: you can see in the dark.
message.windyorigins.volta.low_health: Hey! You won't last like this!
message.windyorigins.volta.quiet_on: Fine. I'll be quiet for %s min. But you can't ask again for %s.
message.windyorigins.volta.how_find: Say it in chat: "Volta, find diamonds", or a mob, or a player's name.
message.windyorigins.volta.how_fetch: Say it in chat: "Volta, bring coal". Any item, by its name. The chest only has to be in your view.
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.steps: Did you hear that? No? Never mind.
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.gift: A present! Well, it's yours anyway.
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.mirror: Left is right, right is left - enjoy!
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.rename: I gave someone a new name. It suits them.
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.tease: Ooh, look! Something shiny over there!
volta.windyorigins.cmd.repair.name: Repair
volta.windyorigins.cmd.repair.desc: Heals 2 hearts at once and gives Regeneration II for 6 seconds; clears poison, wither and fire.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.blink.name: Blink
volta.windyorigins.cmd.blink.desc: Teleport up to 16 blocks to where you are looking.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.toggle.name: Toggle
volta.windyorigins.cmd.toggle.desc: Opens a door (iron ones too) or trapdoor, or flips a lever or button you are looking at, up to 16 blocks away.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.light.name: Light
volta.windyorigins.cmd.light.desc: Places up to 6 of your torches in dark spots nearby. With no torches she gives you Night Vision for 45 seconds.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.dig.name: Tunnel
volta.windyorigins.cmd.dig.desc: Digs a 6-block tunnel; crouching, a staircase down. In chat: "dig 20", "dig down 8", or name a block: "dig up stone", "mine 30 cobblestone", "break the planks" takes that block where you can see it (16 unless you say how many, 64 at most). She works with the right tool from your inventory, wherever it lies: it wears, its enchantments count, and without it stone breaks but drops nothing.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.find.name: Find
volta.windyorigins.cmd.find.desc: Chat only: "Volta, find diamonds / a zombie / Steve". The rarer the thing, the more heat: a plain block 25%, coal, iron, copper 40%, gold, redstone, lapis 55%, diamonds, emeralds, chests 75%, ancient debris 90%. A mob 15%, a player 30%. "Found nothing" costs the same.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.fetch.name: Fetch
volta.windyorigins.cmd.fetch.desc: Chat only: "Volta, bring coal", "bring the diamond pickaxe". Any item, by its name in any of the ten languages. Takes a stack from a chest, barrel or shulker box anywhere in your view, up to 24 blocks away: you need not look straight at it, but not through walls and not behind your back. Glass does not hide a chest.
hud.windyorigins.volta.hint: Mouse to choose · release to send · wheel or centre for next page
origin.windyorigins.dreamwalker.name: Dreamwalker
origin.windyorigins.dreamwalker.descript: You walk where others sleep. A touch sends any creature into a dream, and you can follow it inside - to steal what it dreams of, or to hunt a sleeping player in their own head. Your body stays behind, asleep and defenceless.
power.windyorigins.dream_touch.name: Lulling Touch
power.windyorigins.dream_touch.descripti: [Primary Active] Puts the creature you look at, within 4 blocks, to sleep: a mob for 10 seconds, a player is lulled for 8: slowed, swaying, with blurred sight and every action coming late. Damage wakes them. Not bosses. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Inside a dream: Blink - a jump of up to 8 blocks.
power.windyorigins.dream_enter.name: Into the Dream
power.windyorigins.dream_enter.descripti: [Secondary active] Enter the dream of a sleeper within 6 blocks. A mob's dream is a floating island of its world: gather 1–3 reveries past the nightmare guards. Together the reveries are worth one kill's loot from that mob; gather some and you get a share. The same mob's dream can be entered once every 20 minutes, and it gives up loot no more than three times in its whole life; after that its dreams are empty. A player's dream is a hunt: they look for three anchors and you must defeat them first (crouch for a sweet dream instead: they wake with Regeneration and Luck). Your real body sleeps where you stood; a blow to it wakes you. In a dream: raises a pillar where you look, crouching lowers one.
power.windyorigins.dream_powers.name: Dreamer's Might
power.windyorigins.dream_powers.descript: In dreams you are light - fast, high-jumping, no fall damage - you strike half again as hard and take a fifth less. In a dream everyone fights bare-handed, with nothing from the waking world.
power.windyorigins.dream_summon.name: Nightmare
power.windyorigins.dream_summon.descript: [Save Toolbar key] In a player's dream: call a Shade or a Grabber to harry your opponent, at most two at a time. They cannot finish anyone - the last blow must be yours. Crouching: Thickening - the dream's light goes out around where you look, and anyone standing in it is wrapped in Darkness.
power.windyorigins.sleep_anywhere.name: Sleep Anywhere
power.windyorigins.sleep_anywhere.descri: At night, with no sleeper in sight, Into the Dream lays you down to sleep on the spot - it counts for skipping the night.
power.windyorigins.phantom_kin.name: Phantom Kin
power.windyorigins.phantom_kin.descripti: Phantoms leave you alone - unless you have not slept for three days. Then they come, and insomnia weighs on you.
power.windyorigins.dream_sense.name: Dream Sense
power.windyorigins.dream_sense.descripti: You see a haze of sleep over every sleeping creature within 24 blocks.
power.windyorigins.lullaby.name: Lullaby
power.windyorigins.lullaby.description: Sleeping creatures do not wake for you: a roosting bat stays hanging, a curled-up fox keeps dozing as you pass.
power.windyorigins.drowsy.name: Drowsy
message.windyorigins.dream.recoil: Your mind is still reeling - not yet.
message.windyorigins.dream.too_strong: This one's dreams are beyond you.
message.windyorigins.dream.no_dimension: The dream world is missing on this server.
message.windyorigins.dream.taken: Someone is already in that dream.
message.windyorigins.dream.dreamt_recent: It dreamt not long ago. Let it rest another %s.
message.windyorigins.dream.sweet_woke: You wake rested from a sweet dream.
message.windyorigins.dream.sweet_done: You sent them a sweet dream.
message.windyorigins.dream.goal_walker: Defeat the dreamer before they find three anchors!
message.windyorigins.dream.goal_dreamer: You are dreaming! Find three anchors of light to wake up - something is hunting you.
message.windyorigins.dream.goal_duel: A dreamers' duel: only one of you wakes the winner.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.complete: The dream is emptied - you wake.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.killed: You died in the dream - and woke up. Its spoils are lost.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.won: You won the dream fight - and wake up.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.lost: You lost the dream fight - and wake up.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.draw: The dream fight ends with no winner.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.body: Something struck your body - you wake.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.struck: The dreamer was struck - the dream collapses.
message.windyorigins.dream.end.faded: The dreamer is gone - the dream fades away.
message.windyorigins.dream.no_thicken: The dark has not gathered again yet.
power.windyorigins.harmless_reflection.d: Hostile creatures do not notice or attack you while you carry no Guilt. Bosses and the Warden are not fooled.
power.windyorigins.reflected_pain.name: Reflected Pain
power.windyorigins.reflected_pain.descri: The mirror returns the blow: 30% of the damage you deal to a living creature is dealt to you at once, ignoring armour, never less than half a heart.
power.windyorigins.guilt.name: Guilt
power.windyorigins.guilt.description: Striking a living creature gives you Guilt for 30 seconds: mobs see you again and you take 30% more damage. Every hit in the Normal World also brings Reality Toxicity 2 seconds closer.
message.windyorigins.mirror.banished: You have been banished to the other phase. You will return in %s min, or at once if you charge a respawn anchor.
message.windyorigins.mirror.countdown: Banished: %s · a respawn anchor brings you back at once
message.windyorigins.mirror.returned: You are back in your own phase
message.windyorigins.mirror.anchor: The respawn anchor pulled you back
power.windyorigins.fold_knot.name: Fold Knot
power.windyorigins.fold_knot.description: [Save Toolbar key] Crumples space at the point you are looking at, up to 48 blocks away, for 6 seconds. Everything alive within 4.5 blocks is mired (Slowness IV), tugged towards the centre and outlined for you through walls. A rifle hit on a mired target refunds 15 Fold. Costs 25 Fold. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
power.windyorigins.shot_trace.name: Shot Trace
power.windyorigins.shot_trace.descriptio: A shot tears space and gives you away: after every shot you glow through walls for everyone for 4 seconds.
death.attack.windyorigins.fold_shot: %1$s was pierced by a shot from the fold
death.attack.windyorigins.fold_shot.play: %1$s was pierced by a shot from the fold fired by %2$s
message.windyorigins.sanguine.no_blood: There is no blood in it
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.2: Sea blood: you breathe underwater and swim fast
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.3: Fiery blood: fire cannot hurt you
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.5: Warlike blood: your blows hit harder
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.6: Peaceful blood: the thirst stays away longer
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.7: End blood: you see in the dark
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.9: Livestock blood: your hands work faster
message.windyorigins.sanguine.taste.12: Springy blood: falls cannot hurt you
power.windyorigins.waking_frailty.name: Waking Frailty
power.windyorigins.waking_frailty.descri: You are strong asleep, not awake: outside dreams you take 15% more damage.
power.windyorigins.faded_form.name: Faded Form
power.windyorigins.faded_form.descriptio: You are almost transparent: your body shows at only 15%. Armour and held items show as usual.
message.windyorigins.revenant.wisp.summo: The wisps are with you. Give them a task
message.windyorigins.revenant.wisp.busy: All wisps are busy or resting
message.windyorigins.volta.quiet_already: I'm already quiet. %s s to go.
message.windyorigins.volta.quiet_refuse: Nope. I was just quiet. Ask again in %s min.
message.windyorigins.volta.unknown.0: Didn't get that. Keep it simple: "find diamonds", "hit the zombie", "dig 10".
message.windyorigins.volta.unknown.1: I can't do that… or I misheard. Ask "what can you do".
message.windyorigins.volta.help: Zap, infect, blind, fling, hijack and drain enemies; swap places with them and hang them in the air; decoy, turret, barrier, slowed time, rewind; blink, repair, scan; magnet, doors, light; dig, build, fell trees and veins; find blocks, mobs and players; fetch things from chests. Just not all at once: the chip isn't made of iron.
message.windyorigins.volta.status_warm: Warming up: %s%%. A couple more and that's it.
message.windyorigins.volta.status_hot: %s%%! One more request and I black out. Let me cool!
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.hello.0: Hi hi! What are we doing?
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.thanks.2: Thanks won't pay the power bill. Still nice.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.how.0: Great. Hanging in your head, looking through your eyes.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.how.1: A bit bored. Shall we blow something up?
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.who.0: I'm Volta. I live in the chip in your temple.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.joke.0: A creeper walks into a bar… There is no bar any more.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.joke.1: Why won't the skeleton fight? No guts.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.joke.2: A joke? Look at your armour.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.love.1: I've got used to you too. Don't get cocky.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.love.2: I'll remember that. And bring it up~
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.insult.0: Rude. I can scramble your keys, you know.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.insult.1: One more word and you find your own diamonds.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.insult.2: I hear everything. I'm in your head.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.bye.0: I'm not going anywhere. I'm in the chip.
message.windyorigins.volta.talk.bye.1: Bye-bye. Call me if you need me.
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.invert: I swapped your keys around. Get used to it~
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.fake_de: Kidding! You should have seen your face.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.overload.name: Overload
volta.windyorigins.cmd.overload.desc: A bolt of energy leaves your screen for the target: 4 hearts of damage and Slowness, then it jumps to two enemies nearby for 2 hearts each.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.virus.name: Virus
volta.windyorigins.cmd.virus.desc: Infects the target for 8 seconds: damage every second and Weakness. After 3 seconds, or when its carrier dies, the virus jumps to an enemy nearby, up to three times.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.blind.name: Optics Glitch
volta.windyorigins.cmd.blind.desc: A mob goes blind and cannot pick any target for 6 seconds. A player gets Blindness, Darkness and static on screen.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.impulse.name: Impulse
volta.windyorigins.cmd.impulse.desc: Flings the target away and up. Crouch (or say "pull") to yank it towards you.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.puppet.name: Puppet
volta.windyorigins.cmd.puppet.desc: A hostile mob fights for you for 15 seconds. Not bosses.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.decoy.name: Decoy
volta.windyorigins.cmd.decoy.desc: A hologram of Volta where you are looking, for 8 seconds: hostile mobs within 14 blocks leave you and go for it.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.scan.name: Scan
volta.windyorigins.cmd.scan.desc: A wave out to 32 blocks: enemies and players show through walls for 12 seconds.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.magnet.name: Magnet
volta.windyorigins.cmd.magnet.desc: Pulls nearby items and experience to you for 3.5 seconds.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.build.name: Build
volta.windyorigins.cmd.build.desc: A bridge ahead from the blocks in your inventory; crouching, a 3×3 wall. In chat: "bridge 16", "build a wall".
volta.windyorigins.cmd.harvest.name: Harvest
volta.windyorigins.cmd.harvest.desc: Look at a log or an ore: Volta fells the whole tree (up to 48 logs) or clears the vein (up to 24 blocks). She works with the right tool from your inventory: it wears and its enchantments count. The more she takes, the hotter the chip.
power.windyorigins.chip_broken.name: Fragile Chip
power.windyorigins.chip_broken.descripti: A blow can break the chip: 2.5% for every point of damage (half a heart) that gets through your armour, but no more than 20% a blow. With a broken chip Volta is silent, no command works and static tears at your screen for good. Only a Chip Repair Kit mends it: see the next entry for how to craft one. The chip's own overheating and hunger do not break it.
power.windyorigins.chip_repair_recipe.de: The only thing that mends a broken chip. Craft it at a crafting table, row by row. Top: redstone dust in the middle. Middle: copper ingot, amethyst shard, copper ingot. Bottom: gold ingot in the middle. The recipe is in your recipe book from the start. To use it, hold it and keep right-click held for 2 seconds.
item.windyorigins.chip_repair_kit.toolti: For a Host: hold right-click for 2 seconds to mend a broken chip
item.windyorigins.chip_repair_kit.recipe: Middle: copper ingot, amethyst shard, copper ingot
message.windyorigins.volta.chip_broken_h: The chip is broken. You need a %s: hold right-click with it for 2 seconds
message.windyorigins.volta.chip_recipe: %s, crafting table. Top row: redstone dust in the middle. Middle row: copper ingot, amethyst shard, copper ingot. Bottom row: gold ingot in the middle.
message.windyorigins.volta.chip_fixed: …I'm back! Don't fall like that again, okay?
message.windyorigins.volta.chip_fine: The chip is fine, nothing to mend
message.windyorigins.volta.shield: Covered. One hit is on me.
message.windyorigins.volta.no_rewind: I've nowhere to rewind you to yet.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.siphon.name: Siphon
volta.windyorigins.cmd.siphon.desc: A cord of energy latches on to the target for 4 seconds: every half second it loses ¾ of a heart and you gain half a heart. It snaps if the target leaves your sight or gets more than 24 blocks away.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.swap.name: Swap
volta.windyorigins.cmd.swap.desc: You and the target instantly trade places. Not bosses.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.gravity.name: Zero Gravity
volta.windyorigins.cmd.gravity.desc: Every enemy within 7 blocks floats up and hangs helpless for a second and a half, then is thrown at the ground: 2 hearts of damage on top of the fall.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.turret.name: Turret
volta.windyorigins.cmd.turret.desc: A node of energy where you are looking (up to 16 blocks) for 12 seconds: every second and a half it hits the nearest enemy within 8 blocks for 1.5 hearts.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.shield.name: Barrier
volta.windyorigins.cmd.shield.desc: For 6 seconds a barrier waits for a blow: the very next damage is swallowed whole and the attacker thrown back. If nothing hits it, it is wasted.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.timewarp.name: Slow Time
volta.windyorigins.cmd.timewarp.desc: For 5 seconds everything within 10 blocks of you barely moves: creatures all but freeze and strike more slowly, and arrows and other shots flying at you bog down in the air. The chip does not cool while it lasts.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.rewind.name: Rewind
volta.windyorigins.cmd.rewind.desc: Puts you back where you were 4–5 seconds ago, with the health you had then if it was higher. Puts out fire.
message.windyorigins.folded.aimed: A fold rifle is aimed at you
message.windyorigins.revenant.wisp.crowd: Two wisps are on them already: no room for a third
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.blackou: Guess who turned the lights off?
message.windyorigins.volta.prank.whistle: Hey, everyone, over here! Fresh meat!
message.windyorigins.dream.drained: Its dreams have been drained dry: there is no loot left in them
volta.windyorigins.cmd.quiet.name: Quiet
volta.windyorigins.cmd.quiet.desc: Volta holds her tongue and her pranks for 3 minutes; after that she cannot be asked again for 20. In chat: "Volta, be quiet", and "Volta, speak" to bring her back early.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.stop.name: Stop
volta.windyorigins.cmd.stop.desc: Drops everything at once: digging, building, the turret, the decoy, the magnet, the siphon, slowed time. Costs nothing.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.status.name: Status
volta.windyorigins.cmd.status.desc: Volta says how hot the chip is. Costs nothing.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.help.name: Help
volta.windyorigins.cmd.help.desc: Volta lists what she can do. Costs nothing.
volta.windyorigins.cmd.pvp.name: Players: fair game
volta.windyorigins.cmd.pvp_off.name: Players: hands off
volta.windyorigins.cmd.pvp.desc: A switch, off until you turn it on. On: players are enemies like any monster. Aimed abilities work on them, the turret fires at them, an overload arcs to them, a virus jumps to them, gravity lifts them, a hijacked mob goes for them. Never by her own choice at your team, at spectators or at players in creative. Off: nothing of Volta's touches another player. In chat: "Volta, hit players" and "Volta, don't touch players".
message.windyorigins.volta.pvp_on: Players are targets now. The turret and the rest won't pass them by.
message.windyorigins.volta.spared: That's a player. You told me hands off.
message.windyorigins.volta.mine_none: I don't see any "%s" from here. Face it: I only dig what you can see.
message.windyorigins.volta.no_tool: No tool for this in your pockets. I'll break it anyway, but it won't drop.
